name: agent-steps
useFor: Use while an agent works. Give each step a `status` from the run, or `frame`. `live` shows steps as they start, shimmers the current label and draws a rail between nodes. `size="sm"` is the glyph for a tile. `running` loops a demo.
title: Agent steps
description: What the agent is doing: steps as nodes and labels, done, current or pending, with a live mode that reports as a run does.
